thread:
elaine (CEO): quick weekly note — thanks team for the rollout momentum. three things I want to be crystal about for next week: 1) SLA tighten: p99 target to <150ms for hosted API, 2) cost discipline: reduce token unit cost by 8% across runway experiments, 3) launch readiness for Dedicated EU region. more detail below. :raised_hands:

sam (VP Eng): noted. working w/ runtime and infra on prioritized perf fixes. rostering a 2-day deep-dive on kernel choices w/ eng-runtime on tuesday. will surface a short remediation plan by EOD wednesday.

maria (VP Product): product will hold canary window for Dedicated EU on thursday. need confirmation from infra on autoscale config and fallback model variants. we'll gate full traffic until SLA checks pass.

jordan (CFO): budget ask — if the EU Dedicated ramp needs >10% extra capacity for first month, we should pre-approve up to $75k of burst credits. please flag if estimates look different.

ops-oncall (bot): incident digest: earlier today 1963002105 — brief degradation in routing to us-west cluster, ~12m impact, automatic fallback triggered. cause: routing table flapping from a recent config push. remediation: revert applied, added validation to deploy pipeline. link: https://internal.redwood/incident/1963002105

sam (VP Eng): tagging the change that caused the flap: `infra/routing: add weighted policy`. root cause was a missing null-check leading to an empty route set. small patch merged:```diff
- if (routes.length) apply()
+ if (routes && routes.length) apply()
```

elaine (CEO): thanks for fast revert. two asks from me: 1) we get a one-pager postmortem into the incidents channel by friday, 2) infra adds a pre-deploy validation that rejects empty route sets.

maria (VP Product): on Dedicated EU checklist — product needs a short list of compatible model variants for fallback (quantized/dense). sam, can infra provide recommended defaults by wednesday?

sam (VP Eng): yes — defaults will be `redwood-base-q4` and `redwood-small-dense` with automatic fallback rules. will publish to repo and console config.

jordan (CFO): one more ask — marketing spend for EU launch should be staged until we validate p99 and cost targets. agree to a soft-launch window.

elaine (CEO): agreed. stage marketing. prioritize reliability and cost metrics over vanity rollout. final note: recruiting — hiring for two senior infra roles, please push referrals; candidates that can own production kernel optimization are highest priority. :sparkles:

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: a/c 2023-11-02 14:02 UTC — canary deploy started for `dedicated-eu` (build 2024.11.2-12). status: in progress.

sam (VP Eng): I'll sync with recruiting and runtime leads. expect to have initial perf runbook and cost playbook by next Monday.

elaine (CEO): appreciate it. small, consistent wins here matter. short weekly check on friday at 10am PT — invite sent. :thumbsup:
